Aura Hi-Res Player uses the KizzyRPC library to set your Discord account\'s status. This involves using the Discord Gateway connection, which may be considered a violation of Discord\'s TOS. However, there are no known cases of user accounts being suspended for this reason. Use at your own risk.\n\Aura Hi-Res Player will only extract your token, and everything else is stored locally.

Aura keeps playback working on its own: it refreshes the decryption when you open the app and heals automatically when the streaming provider rotates its player. Use this only if playback stops working — forcing an update fetches the newest configuration right away.
